about: A ground skill aimed at a wall cell out of range (issue #592): a Mage at prontera 136,120 aims Thunderstorm (range 9) at 136,103, inside a building 17 cells north. The walk goes to the chase cell 9 cells short (no path to the wall is needed) and the skill is cast from there. It used to be dropped, since no path reaches a wall cell. The scenario takes the hotkey off and goes back to Novice.
